scientific_integrity: Infinite theorem established by explicit color-change case analysis and exact combinatorial enumeration. Finite independent rule simulation is supporting evidence only; no formal or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary zero forcing only, two bipartition sizes at least three and deleted edges forming a matching. Neither small-part boundaries nor other forcing variants are asserted. The full text of the 2013 thesis arxiv:1311.7672 was unavailable and is a prior-art risk.
title: Zero forcing sets of complete bipartite graphs with a deleted matching
